{
  "name": "headroom",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "description": "Your Claude plan limits, a forecast of when you'll run out, and your context window, live in a band above the prompt. Compacts in one click, automatically, or when Claude picks the moment, and keeps the prompt cache warm",
  "author": {
    "name": "Martin Hygge",
    "url": "https://github.com/MWEJ"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/MWEJ/claude-code-headroom",
  "repository": "https://github.com/MWEJ/claude-code-headroom",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "headroom",
    "usage",
    "rate limits",
    "context window",
    "compact",
    "prompt cache",
    "mod"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "cacheTtl": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Keep cache warm: lifetime",
      "description": "The prompt cache lifetime a new chat's Keep cache warm starts with. auto follows Claude Code's own choice (1h on a subscription within its limits, 5m on an API key or in overage); 5m or 1h sets it while warming is on. A 1h write costs 2x input instead of 1.25x.",
      "default": "auto",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "5m",
        "1h"
      ]
    },
    "idle5m": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Keep cache warm: idle refreshes, 5m",
      "description": "Refreshes a 5-minute cache gets while the session is idle, 0 to 20; each still needs a $0.05 expected saving.",
      "default": 5,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 20
    },
    "idle1h": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Keep cache warm: idle refreshes, 1h",
      "description": "Refreshes a 1-hour cache gets while the session is idle, 0 to 20; each still needs a $0.05 expected saving.",
      "default": 5,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 20
    },
    "warmUntil": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Keep cache warm: until a limit reaches %",
      "description": "No refresh is sent while the 5 Hour or Weekly limit is at or past this %: a refresh counts against your plan like any request.",
      "default": 85,
      "min": 1,
      "max": 100
    }
  }
}
